assumptions: Every sample shows the same populations as density peaks on each normalized channel; gaussNorm moves peaks, it cannot tell a missing population from a shifted one.
limits: The normalized files are written to the project from the panel only; this door returns the landmarks and confidence.
Values are not compensated first, as flowStats runs on the frames flowCore reads.
bio.jane/contract.question: Do the same populations sit at the same place on each channel across these samples, and if not, by how much must each be moved?

description: flowStats gaussNorm batch normalization over project FCS files: per channel, each sample's density peaks (landmarks) are found, scored by sharpness and height, matched to base landmarks (the median of each landmark class across samples), and the sample's values shifted so its landmarks land on them, each shift spread by a Gaussian around its peak; values read as flowCore reads them (linear, uncompensated) or their log10, and events at a channel's instrument range left raw.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

channels.description: the channels to normalize, comma-separated PnN; empty for every channel but scatter and time.

landmark_scale.description: the values peaks are found on: flowCore's linear values, or their log10 (every value must be above 0). Values: log10 (log10), linear (linear).

max_lms.description: flowStats max.lms: landmarks moved per channel; 0 leaves a channel as it is.

peak_density_thr.description: a peak lower than this share of the highest peak scores 0 (flowStats peak.density.thr).

peak_distance_thr.description: of two peaks closer than this share of the range, only the better scored is kept (flowStats peak.distance.thr).

samples.description: the FCS files to normalize together, by name or id, comma-separated; empty for every FCS file in the project.

name: normalize_flow_cytometry_batch

base_landmarks.description: per channel, the base landmarks every sample was moved to

confidence.description: per sample, flowStats' confidence (1 down to 0.6^k as its landmarks sit far from the others')

shifts.description: per channel and sample, each landmark found and the base landmark it was moved to
